_help: status is 'earned' or 'in-progress'. In-progress items are always labelled as such on the page. Dates are YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD. image can be a .png/.jpg/.webp scan or a .pdf in assets/. The entry marked example: true is a format sample: it is left out of the build unless you run `node build.mjs --examples`. Delete it when you've added a real one. showWhenEmpty is false, so the section stays hidden until you add a real certificate. Set it to true to show a short "nothing here yet" note instead.
